data.summary: The pod startup was delayed primarily by the application initialisation phase, which took 15.5 seconds. The compute-intensive init.compute task accounted for 12.7 seconds of this duration, likely exacerbated by the restrictive 250m CPU limit.

findings.statement: The app_init phase lasted 15.507 seconds, which is the primary contributor to the 21.0 second total startup time.
The init.compute span was the slowest component of the initialisation, taking 12.687 seconds to process 100 work units.
The container is restricted by a 250m CPU limit, which likely causes throttling during the compute-heavy initialisation phase.

ruled_out.reason: The image pull duration was only 4.074 seconds for 53MB, indicating normal pull performance.
The scheduling phase duration was 0.0 seconds, indicating the pod was scheduled immediately.
The application was marked ready immediately after the initialisation phase completed.

recommendations.action: Increase the CPU limit for the container.
recommendations.rationale: The current 250m limit is likely causing CPU throttling during the compute-intensive init.compute phase.

recommendations.action: Profile and optimise the init.compute function.
recommendations.rationale: This function is the bottleneck of the startup process, consuming 12.7 seconds of the total time.
